arxiv-2005-12889.title: Refining Implicit Argument Annotation for UCCA
arxiv-2005-12889.creator: Ruixiang Cui, Daniel Hershcovich, {rc, dh}@di.ku.dk
arxiv-2005-12889.description: Abstract Predicate-argument structure analysis is a central component in meaning representations of text. The fact that some arguments are not explicitly mentioned in a sentence gives rise to ambiguity in language understanding, and renders it difficult for machines to interpret text correctly.

arxiv-2105-14378.title: The Partition Function of Log-Gases with Multiple Odd Charges
arxiv-2105-14378.creator: Elisha D. Wolff, Jonathan M. Wells
arxiv-2105-14378.description: Abstract We use techniques in the shuffle algebra to present a formula for the partition function of a one-dimensional log-gas comprised of particles of (possibly) different integer charges at certain inverse temperature β \beta in terms of the Berezin integral of an associated non-homogeneous alternating tensor.

arxiv-2111-02910.title: Estimating SARS-CoV-2 Seroprevalence
arxiv-2111-02910.creator: Samuel P. Rosin, Bonnie E. Shook-Sa, Stephen R. Cole, Michael G. Hudgens
arxiv-2111-02910.description: Abstract Governments and public health authorities use seroprevalence studies to guide responses to the COVID-19 pandemic. Seroprevalence surveys estimate the proportion of individuals who have detectable SARS-CoV-2 antibodies. However, serologic assays are prone to misclassification error, and non-probability sampling may induce selection bias.

arxiv-2201-00350.description: Abstract Oil companies are among the largest companies in the world whose economic indicators in the global stock market have a great impact on the world economy ec00 and market due to their relation to gold ec01 , crude oil ec02 , and the dollar ec03 .

arxiv-2211-10451.title: Quantum-classical correspondence of strongly chaotic many-body spin models
arxiv-2211-10451.creator: Luis Benet, Fausto Borgonovi, Felix M. Izrailev, Lea F. Santos
arxiv-2211-10451.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Luis Benet, Fausto Borgonovi, Felix M. Izrailev, Lea F. Santos. We study the quantum-classical correspondence for systems with interacting spin-particles that are strongly chaotic in the classical limit. This is done in the presence of constants of motion associated with the fixed angular momenta of individual spins. Our analysis of the Lyapunov spectra reveals that the largest Lyapunov exponent agrees with the Lyapunov exponent that determines the local instability of each individual spin moving under the influence of all other spins.

arxiv-2212-07283.title: Generative Robust Classification
arxiv-2212-07283.creator: Xuwang Yin
arxiv-2212-07283.description: Abstract Training adversarially robust discriminative (i.e., softmax) classifier has been the dominant approach to robust classification. Building on recent work on adversarial training (AT)-based generative models, we investigate using AT to learn unnormalized class-conditional density models and then performing generative robust classification.

arxiv-2403-16630.title: A comparative analysis of embedding models for patent similarity
arxiv-2403-16630.creator: Grazia Sveva Ascione, Valerio Sterzi
arxiv-2403-16630.description: Abstract This paper makes two contributions to the field of text-based patent similarity. First, it compares the performance of different kinds of patent-specific pretrained embedding models, namely static word embeddings (such as word2vec and doc2vec models) and contextual word embeddings (such as transformers based models), on the task of patent similarity calculation.

arxiv-2405-16654.title: Ethics Pathways: A Design Activity for Reflecting on Ethics Engagement in HCI Research Conference: Designing Interactive Systems Conference; July 1–5, 2024; IT University of Copenhagen, Denmark Designing Interactive Systems Conference (DIS ’24), July 1–5, 2024, IT University of Copenhagen, Denmark D
arxiv-2405-16654.creator: Inha Cha, Ajit G. Pillai, Richmond Wong
arxiv-2405-16654.description: Abstract . This paper introduces Ethics Pathways , a design activity aimed at understanding HCI and design researchers’ ethics engagements and flows during their research process. Despite a strong ethical commitment in these fields, challenges persist in grasping the complexity of researchers’ engagement with ethics —practices conducted to operationalize ethics—in situated institutional contexts.

arxiv-2406-02429.title: Self-Supervised Singing Voice Pre-Training towards Speech-to-Singing Conversion
arxiv-2406-02429.creator: Ruiqi Li, Rongjie Huang, Yongqi Wang, Zhiqing Hong, Zhou Zhao
arxiv-2406-02429.description: Abstract Speech-to-singing voice conversion (STS) task always suffers from data scarcity, because it requires paired speech and singing data. Compounding this issue are the challenges of content-pitch alignment and the suboptimal quality of generated outputs, presenting significant hurdles in STS research. This paper presents SVPT, an STS approach boosted by a self-supervised singing voice pre-training model.

arxiv-2504-17965.title: Quantum Fisher-Yates shuffle: Unifying methods for generating uniform superpositions of permutations
arxiv-2504-17965.creator: Lennart Binkowski, Marvin Schwiering
arxiv-2504-17965.description: Abstract Uniform superpositions over permutations play a central role in quantum error correction, cryptography, and combinatorial optimisation. We introduce a simple yet powerful quantisation of the classical Fisher–Yates shuffle, yielding a suite of efficient quantum algorithms for preparing such superpositions on composite registers.

arxiv-2506-10636.creator: Wei Chen, Giacomo Dimarco, Lorenzo Pareschi
arxiv-2506-10636.description: Abstract The high dimensionality of kinetic equations with stochastic parameters poses major computational challenges for uncertainty quantification (UQ). Traditional Monte Carlo (MC) sampling methods, while widely used, suffer from slow convergence and high variance, which become increasingly severe as the dimensionality of the parameter space grows.

pmc-11538510.description: The Chinese Grouse (Tetrastes sewerzowi), a rare endemic bird in China, belongs to the Galliformes order and Tetraonidae family. Despite extensive research, subspecies classification remains inadequate, especially in Pingwu, Sichuan. This study sequenced the mitochondrial genome of T. sewerzowi in Wanglang Nature Reserve, Sichuan, analyzed its structural features, and reconstructed phylogenetic relationships within Tetraonidae.

pmc-11728135.title: Dielectric, Electric, and Pyroelectric Properties of Ba1−xCaxTiO3 Ceramics
pmc-11728135.creator: Kamil Feliksik, Jolanta Makowska, Joanna A. Bartkowska, Tomasz Pikula, Rafał Panek, Oliwia Starczewska, Małgorzata Adamczyk-Habrajska
pmc-11728135.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, we investigate the dielectric, electric, and pyroelectric properties of Ba1−xCaxTiO3 (BCT) ceramics with compositions of x = 0.2, 0.25, and 0.3. The ceramics were synthesized using the solid-state reaction method. A microstructural analysis was performed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), revealing that calcium concentration influences grain size and morphology, with BCT20 showing larger, hexagonal grains, while BCT25 and BCT30 exhibited smaller, irregular grains.
